Overview - Magnetic Coolant Filter
A filter you clean and put back
Iron holds to the rods
Lift the rods out
Wipe them clean
Refit and run
Liquid in
Clean liquid out
Magnetic rods
Iron in the coolant holds to the rods. To clean, lift the rods out, wipe them and refit them.
Pause

Fluid enters the housing, passes over a cluster of high strength magnetic rods and leaves clean. Iron and steel particles hold to the rods, including the fine wear particles that pass through a paper or bag filter.
The housing does not block as it loads, so the flow to the machine stays constant. When the rods are full, lift the assembly out, wipe it clean and refit it. Nothing is thrown away.

Used on grinding machines, machining centres, honing and lapping machines, wire cut machines and parts washers. Suitable for water based coolants, neat oils, hydraulic oil and wash solutions. Stainless steel construction suits corrosive fluids.

Lifting and Handling
Lift steel with one person and one lever
A permanent magnetic lifter picks up a steel plate, block or round bar with no chains, slings or clamps. Set it on the load, turn the handle, and lift. Turn the handle back and the load is released.
The magnets are neodymium. There is no power supply and no battery, so the hold cannot fail in a power cut. The handle locks in the on position.
The Maxx range has twelve models from 100 kg to 6,000 kg. Every lifter is tested to three times its safe working load before it leaves the works.
Lifting range
What changes on the shop floor
Nobody reaches under the load to fit or release slings. The plate hangs level from one point. Finished surfaces are lifted without marks. One person moves a plate in seconds.

Round loads are rated at half the flat figure. Each model has a minimum plate thickness for its full rating. Keep the contact face clean and the load below 80 degrees Celsius. Our guide on {1}safer lifting{/1} covers the checks.

There is no power supply, so the hold cannot fail in a power cut. The handle locks in the on position. Round loads are rated at half the flat load, and each model has a minimum plate thickness for its full rating. The full table is under Technical Data.

Overview - Deep Field Magnetic Plate Separator
Tramp iron out of a thick flow

A plate magnet over a conveyor pulls bolts, nuts, wire and tool pieces up out of the moving product. A deep field version is built for thick beds, where a standard plate would only reach the top layer.
The plate is cleaned by swinging it clear of the belt and wiping the face. There is nothing to drive and nothing to replace.
Steel belt support rollers under the magnet should be changed to non-magnetic ones so that they do not draw the field away. Plates are made to the belt width and bed depth.
